svg.title: ISO 230 geometric test set-ups
svg.text: straight edge on the pallet, indicator on the spindle
readings every 50–100 mm; end-point line removed
reversal: turn the edge over → removes its own error
granite square on the pallet, indicator moved along Y
1) indicator reads along the square face: m₁
e.g. +6 and −2 µm/400 → machine 2 µm/400 = 5 µm/m
test mandrel in the taper, indicators at nose + 300 mm
turn the spindle slowly by hand, read max − min
test bar at 0°, 90°, 180°, 270° in the taper → average
G15: move Z 300 mm, indicator on the bar →
positioning accuracy + repeatability of each axis
cosine error = L·θ²/2: 1 mm over 1 m → 0.5 µm
steel scale: 11.5 µm/(m·K) → 0.8 m, 1.1 K: 10 µm
result: A, B, E, M, R (§E4)
R 150 mm, F 1000 mm/min, CW + CCW, after warm-up
same R, F, plane, program every time → trend file
(f) the 6 errors of one linear axis (X)
measure: E_XX laser; E_YX/E_ZX straight edge or
laser straightness; E_AX electronic level (2 heads);
E_BX level or laser angular; E_CX laser angular
Abbe: pitch 20 µrad × offset 300 mm = 6 µm
EXAMPLE – check the maker's installation manual
